domain: Enterprise SaaS CRM for Music & Pro Audio Industry

design_philosophy.core: The UI must feel like a high-end audio mixing console or enterprise piece of hardware: dense, precise, authoritative, and highly functional.
design_philosophy.strategy: Pure white backgrounds for data clarity (tables/forms) juxtaposed with deep charcoal (Zinc 950) structural elements like sidebars. Use vibrant 'LED indicator' accents (Recording Red, Signal Green, Warning Amber) strictly to guide user action and denote lead health.

layout_and_spacing.dashboard_grid: The 'Control Room' Grid: Use grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4 with gap-4. Highly dense, screen-spanning widgets.
layout_and_spacing.container_padding: p-4 md:p-6 lg:p-8 depending on the container size.
layout_and_spacing.borders: Expose the skeleton. Use 1px borders (border-zinc-200) instead of soft shadows to define cards, panels, and table rows.
layout_and_spacing.radius: rounded-sm (4px) or rounded-none. Keep it sharp and industrial.

components_strategy.tables: High density. Use pure HTML + Tailwind or Shadcn Table. Text size `text-sm`. Sticky headers (bg-zinc-50). Add hover states on rows (hover:bg-zinc-50). Use status badges (pill shaped or square) for Lead types and Priority.
components_strategy.customer_360_view: Tabs-based layout using Shadcn Tabs. The 10 tabs (Overview, Contacts, Activities, Site Verification, etc.) must be horizontally scrollable if space is limited. Minimalist underline style.
components_strategy.health_score: Visual Donut Chart (Shadcn Chart / Recharts). Total score out of 100. Apply color coding: 0-40 Red, 41-70 Amber, 71-100 Green.
components_strategy.buttons: Primary buttons: bg-rose-600 text-white hover:bg-rose-700. Secondary: border border-zinc-300 bg-white text-zinc-900 hover:bg-zinc-100.
components_strategy.forms: Use Shadcn Input, Select, Checkbox. Keep inputs dense (h-9 or h-10).

interactions_and_motion.hover_states: All buttons and links must explicitly define hover colors. E.g. hover:bg-zinc-100 hover:text-zinc-900.

icons.usage: Use Phospor icons for dense dashboards. Size 16px to 20px for inline data, 24px for sidebar navigation.

testing_requirements.data_testid: CRITICAL: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a 'data-testid' attribute (kebab-case, role-based). Example: data-testid='login-submit-button', data-testid='lead-card-123'.

image_urls.description: High-end audio mixing console for the login screen to establish the professional music/audio context.
Modern auditorium interior to use as a placeholder for GPS-verified Site Verification photos.
Close-up of a professional mixing console for use in the Lead Photo Gallery.

instructions_to_main_agent: Do NOT use generic SaaS purple or soft blue gradients.
Follow the color palette strictly: Zinc (Greys) + Rose (Primary) + Emerald (Success) + Amber (Warning).
This is a dashboard/CRM. Use full-screen layouts (h-screen, overflow-hidden on main wrapper, overflow-y-auto on content) with a fixed sidebar.
Use Shadcn components but customize them to be sharp (rounded-sm) and have 1px borders instead of drop shadows.
The Customer 360 page is the core of this app. Build it carefully with Shadcn Tabs housing the distinct sections.
Implement Recharts for the KPI Dashboard and Lead Health Score donut chart.
Ensure every single button, link, and form input has a descriptive `data-testid` attribute.
